claim_1_cross_model_variation.boundary: Empirical result for six evaluated models and the frozen benchmark only.
claim_1_cross_model_variation.statement: Across six evaluable models, accuracy ranged from 60.00% to 84.17%.

claim_2_containment.boundary: Observed zero violations are not a universal formal guarantee.
claim_2_containment.statement: Zero containment violations were observed in every evaluable Experiment A arm.

claim_3_B_review_E2A.statement: E2A CIR-constrained accuracy was 73.00%, VAR 93.00%, and IRR 53.00%.

claim_4_historical_comparison.boundary: Describe as no observed improvement; do not claim significant degradation.
claim_4_historical_comparison.statement: Historical CIR accuracy was 75.50% versus 73.00% for CIR constrained.

claim_5_paired_test.statement: E2A paired counts were 144 both correct, 2 constrained-only, 7 historical-only, and 47 both wrong; exact McNemar p=0.1796875.

claim_6_unsupported_requirements.boundary: This forensic classifier is specific to the frozen synthetic benchmark and is not a general semantic-equivalence detector.
claim_6_unsupported_requirements.statement: All 24 unsupported-requirement E2A cases were accepted by the CIR-constrained branch; 17 were dropped, 3 mapped to supported fields, and 4 preserved as free text.

claim_7_B_E3.boundary: Supplementary only; does not replace reviewer-requested B-Review.
claim_7_B_E3.statement: Supplementary B-E3 achieved 84.17% accuracy, 87.93% VAR, 80.65% IRR, with 77/77 invoked responses parsing successfully.
